findings: `historical_glyphs.items[1].period`: “Qin/Han seal-script tradition represented by the Shuowen seal style” overstates what the evidence supports. The cited page identifies a modern redraw of Shuowen seal-script style, but does not establish that this specific form dates to the Qin/Han period. Replace the period with a qualified label such as “Shuowen seal-script style (modern redraw; historical date of this depicted form not established here).”
